summary: A concurrent SD-35 Epic 6 (PCGen exit) agent's repo-root-wide codemod crossed into this isolated worker's worktree and turned the Epic 5 wrap-up gate red on work that is not Epic 5's. At 19:11-19:12 local, 15 Rust files plus one atlas JSON under /home/ubuntu/workspace/repos/codex/.claude/worktrees/wf_291be5c8-5f3-35 were rewritten from 'use crate::rules_core::pilot_compute::formula_interpreter' (module exists) to 'use crate::pcgen_import::formula_interpreter' (module does not exist in THIS worktree), while the matching file MOVES into src/pcgen_import/ landed only in the shared checkout (formula_interpreter.rs mtime 19:12, formula_reproduction_harness.rs 19:19, both uncommitted there). Result: verify.sh stage root-full FAIL, cargo exit 101, 10 E0432 unresolved-import errors, 0 of ~490 suites executed. The gate run was killed and the 16 files restored with 'git checkout -- src apps tests docs'. ROOT CAUSE: agent worktrees live UNDER the shared checkout at .claude/worktrees/, so any codemod anchored at the repo root that walks '.' (find/grep -r/xargs sed -i) edits every other agent's tree. NAMED MECHANICAL CONTROL: either (a) create agent worktrees OUTSIDE the repo root, or (b) require every codemod in workflow-instruction.md 6 to be anchored on explicit top-level dirs (src apps tests scripts docs) and never '.', and add '.claude/worktrees' to a repo-root .codemodignore that the dispatch template's sed/grep recipes honour. A caution in a dispatch prompt is not a control (AGENTS.md rule 8).
